title: Call Forty-Seven
summary: Karen reports existential zoning. Each transfer adds a bar of hold music. Democracy is bleeding, Steven. The call never drops.
visualArc: Kitchen cordless → swatches vs driveway → dispatch CALL #47 → sticker → own voicemail → pizza doorbell, still holding.

segments.label: Kitchen cordless
segments.onScreen: Bathrobe, cordless, clipboard, swatches, purple blinds.
segments.lyrics: Call forty-seven. / Cul-de-sac. / Please continue to hold.
segments.musicCue: 92 BPM hold-music Rhodes; one extra bar already
segments.grokImaginePrompt: Photoreal kitchen at night, suburban woman in a bathrobe on a cordless phone, clipboard under one arm, color swatches fanned in the other hand, purple glow through horizontal blinds, deadpan, Grok Imagine style
segments.geminiOmniPrompt: 12-second kitchen hold. She does not pace fast. Photoreal.

segments.label: Swatches vs driveway

segments.lyrics: It's not a portal. It's an unapproved hardscape. / I have the swatches.

segments.label: Dispatch / Steven
segments.lyrics: Ma'am, is anyone bleeding? / Democracy is bleeding, Steven.

segments.label: I survived the purple light

segments.lyrics: Call forty-seven / Cul-de-sac feature / I survived the purple light / I have a sticker that says so

segments.label: Own voicemail

segments.lyrics: I have been transferred to my own voicemail. / I did not leave a message. I am the message.

segments.lyrics: The doorbell. / That is not dispatch. / That is extra napkins. / Please continue to hold.
